answer: Weigh the plume against copper. Register each new agent address behind a trellis of escalating resource gates: the first identity costs a trivial proof-of-work, but every additional identity the same validator sees must burn ten times the prior cost, with the multiplier published per epoch. A sybil farmer cloning fifty wallets pays 10^49 work units while one honest agent pays one, so cloning becomes the most expensive way to lose.
